title: Live preview
steps: Open Live preview. Headings show at their size without #, bold, italic, strikethrough and inline code without their markers, links as their text, a rule as a line, a quote with a bar, and code raw on a light background.
Move the cursor with j and k: the line it's on shows its raw markdown, so w, e, f and x work on the real characters. Try w across **Bold** and x on a marker.
⌘-click a link (Ctrl-click off a Mac) to follow it: the Welcome note, the Reading list, or the web page in a new browser tab. Or put the cursor on one and press gd.
Drop an image into a note (Uploads, #15): once it's up, it shows in the note. Its line shows the raw `![name](/uploads/…)` when the cursor's on it.
Open settings (⌘,) and turn off Live preview: every note shows raw markdown, tasks included, at once. Turn it back on.
